segments.en: For a bad dream, say in the morning, "The dreams speak vainly."
For a good dream, say in a tone of wonderment, "Could it be that dreams speak vainly, when it is written 'In a dream I speak to him,”  (Bamidbar, 12:6).
One who conducts himself modestly in the lavatory his dreams will be settled.

segments.he:
ד.

גַּם יִשְׁמֹר אֶת עַצְמוֹ מִמַּאַכְלֵי אִסּוּר, וְיִשְׁמֹר אֶת פִּיו מִדִּבּוּר אָסוּר.
segments.en: Through speaking disparagingly about a  T zaddik  who has passed away one is shown nightmares.

segments.he:
ה.

מִי שֶׁמְּפַזֵּר מְעוֹתָיו בִּשְׁבִיל לִקְנוֹת לְעַצְמוֹ רַב לִלְמֹד מִמֶּנ ּוּ, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה יִמְצָא חֵן.
segments.en: One who sees nightmares, it is a sign that a son or student will turn heretic in public    (lit. burn the food he is cooking) .

segments.he:
ו.

כְּשֶׁתַּעֲבִיר עַל מִדּוֹתֶיךָ, תִּמְצָא חֵן.
segments.en: SECOND PART :
One who wants his dreams to be realized should write them in his ledger, and the day, the hour, and the place.
GRACE

segments.he:
ט.

סְגֻלָּה לְחֵן תִּכְתֹּב עַל קְלַף; כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת אַלּוּף.
segments.en: Through charity one merits to grace.

segments.he:
י.

עַל־יְדֵי הַיִּרְאָה מִתַּלְמִיד־חָכָם תִּזְכֶּה לְחֵן.
segments.en: Through humility one merits to grace.

segments.he:
יא.

דִּבּוּרִים הַיּוֹצְאִים בְּנִיחוּתָא נִתְקַבְּלִים אֵצֶל בְּנֵי־אָדָם.
segments.en: To find grace, one should be a host to guests.

segments.he:
יב.

יֵשׁ דָּגִים שֶׁהֵם מְסֻגָּלִים לְחֵן.
segments.en: Also, one should guard oneself from forbidden foods, and guard one's mouth from forbidden speech.

segments.he:
יג.

עֵסֶק הַתּוֹרָה בַּדֶּרֶךְ נוֹתֶנֶת חֵן.
segments.en: One who expends money to acquire a rabbi from whom to learn, through this he will find grace.
When you defer, you will find grace.

segments.he:
טו.

כְּשֶׁאָדָם בָּא לְעִיר לָדוּר, יִשְׁלַח בָּשָׂר לַעֲנִיֵּי הָעִיר, וְעַל־יְדֵי זֶה יִשָּׂא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי שָׁרֵי הָעִיר.
segments.en: Through [giving] rebuke, you will find grace.
Olive oil is a  segulah (auspicious)  for grace.
A  segulah for finding grace is to write on parchment, "Silver and gold kindness and truth champion."
By the awe  [you have]  for a Torah scholar, you merit to grace.
Words that are spoken (lit. come out) calmly are accepted by people.
There are fish which are conducive to grace.
Learning Torah while traveling gives one grace.
SECOND PART :
When a man comes to a city to live, he should send meat to the poor of the city, and through this he will find grace in the eyes of the city's officials.
